# Nora Shillings

> Nora Shillings (NSH) is a wallet and payments API. 100 Nora Shillings always equal 1 US dollar. People add money with PayPal, a card, or M-Pesa, hold Nora Shillings, send them, pay businesses, and withdraw. Businesses and apps take payment with one API call and pay 1% only on paid payments. Founded in June 2026. Works worldwide.

Key facts:

- Rate: 1 NSH = 1 US cent. 1,000 NSH = 10 USD. The same rate is used to buy, pay, refund, and withdraw.
- Ways to add money: PayPal, card (on PayPal's secure card page), and M-Pesa (prompt on the phone).
- Withdrawals: PayPal or M-Pesa. M-Pesa withdrawals are checked by the Nora team and usually arrive within 1 to 8 hours.
- Pricing: businesses pay 1% of a paid payment. No monthly fee. Refusals are free and refunds return the fee. Wallets are free.
- Accounts: sign up with an email link, no password. Two-step sign-in with passkeys or an authenticator app. Identity is verified once before live withdrawals.
- Sandbox and Live: every account has free Sandbox test money and a Live balance with real money.
- Support: supportnorashillings@benuru.com

## Product

- [Home](https://norashillings.benuru.com/): what Nora Shillings is and how it works
- [Product](https://norashillings.benuru.com/product): the wallet, adding money, sending, paying, withdrawing
- [Business](https://norashillings.benuru.com/business): accepting Nora Shillings in a shop, app, or marketplace
- [Why Nora](https://norashillings.benuru.com/why-nuru): how Nora compares with usual payment processors
- [Sign up](https://norashillings.benuru.com/signup): open a free wallet

## Developers

- [Developers](https://norashillings.benuru.com/developers): overview of the payments API
- [API documentation](https://norashillings.benuru.com/docs): keys, Sandbox and Live, payments, checkout, refunds, webhooks, app deposits, errors
- Base URL: https://norashillings.benuru.com/v1
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer nsh_test_...` (Sandbox) or `nsh_live_...` (Live)
- Endpoints: `POST /v1/payments`, `GET /v1/payments/{id}`, `POST /v1/refunds`, `POST /v1/webhooks`, `POST /v1/deposits`, `GET /v1/deposits/{id}`, `POST /v1/connections/exchange`
- Amounts are whole numbers of NSH sent as strings, for example `"1800"` for 18 USD.
- Webhooks are signed with the `Nuru-Signature` header.
